title: Treaty of Maastricht (1843)
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Treaty of Maastricht (1843)", at revision 1271133640, opens: "The Treaty of Maastricht, signed in 1843 by Belgium and the Netherlands four years after the Treaty of London established Belgian independence, finally settled the border between the two countries." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q7837132, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1843 treaty between Belgium and Nederlands". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
